records.text: Hundreds of thousands of American citizens were sent to concentration camps by Franklin Roosevelt because they were Japanese.
records.speaker: Tucker Carlson

appearances.snippet: definition of nefarious changes, as you know, I mean, hundreds of thousands of American citizens were sent to concentration camps by Franklin Roosevelt because they were Japanese.

verification.notes: National Archives records directly contradict the count and citizenship claim: about 120,000 people of Japanese ancestry were incarcerated, and nearly 70,000 were U.S. citizens. That is not hundreds of thousands of American citizens, although Roosevelt Executive Order 9066 enabled the mass incarceration.

sources.title: National Archives: Japanese-American Incarceration During World War II
sources.relevance: Official record states roughly 112,000 people were sent to assembly centers and nearly 70,000 were U.S. citizens, directly contradicting hundreds of thousands of citizens.
